extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent practitioners, and other stakeholders interested in patent quality (USPTO customers)
extracted.subtask_description: A USPTO webinar series providing information, discussion, and stakeholder input on patent quality topics (presentations ~20 minutes plus Q&A). Covers examination standards, procedural pilots, metrics, filing formats, PTAB practice, and related quality initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of Patent Quality Chat series
rubrics_metrics.description: The Patent Quality Chat series was designed to provide information on patent quality topics and gather your input on a regular basis via an easy, webinar format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each Patent Quality Chat webinar included a speaker(s) presentation for approximately 20 minutes with the remaining time for questions and comments.
